anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
# Draft: Create mode, one ticket

**Title (new):** Export a report as CSV and email it to the requester

## Context

Requesters can view reports in the widgets app, but they cannot get a copy of a report as a CSV file.

## Problem

A requester cannot export the report on screen as a CSV file, and cannot have that file emailed to them. Example: none (the gathered input names no specific report or requester).

## Idea

Reporter's sketch: add an Export CSV button in acme/widgets, and have acme/mailer deliver the exported file.

## Acceptance Criteria

### acme/widgets

- [ ] Given a requester opening a report, when the report loads, then the report view shows an Export CSV button.
- [ ] Given a report showing a set of rows, when the requester clicks Export CSV, then the exported CSV file contains exactly the displayed rows, with the columns `name` and `count`.

### acme/mailer

- [ ] Given a requester who has exported a report's CSV and asked for email delivery, when the delivery is processed, then the mailer sends an email to the requester's address with that CSV file attached.

---

# Gate report (step 5: deterministic gates)

## AC integrity gate (on the assembled draft)

**Normalization:** The three required outcomes were rewritten as `- [ ]` items. The Idea names two repos, so the items sit under `### acme/widgets` and `### acme/mailer`. This grouping only shows which repo owns each item. It is not a split.

| # | AC (short) | Class test | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| W1 | Export CSV button shown on report | Behavioral: setup (open report), action (load), observable (button present) | **Pass** |
| W2 | CSV contains displayed rows, columns `name`, `count` | Behavioral: setup (report with rows), action (click), observable (file contents) | **Pass** |
| M1 | Mailer emails the CSV as an attachment to the requester | Behavioral: setup (export + email request), action (delivery processed), observable (email with attachment at requester's address) | **Pass** |

- **Wishful / tautological:** none. No comparative or "all X" claims. The column set is listed in full today (`name`, `count`).
- **Unspecified-but-binding:** none. No word that gates closure is left without a value.
- **External-input dependency:** none.
- **Post-deployment:** none. All three ACs can be checked before production with representative data. No AC names an environment.
- **Outcome:** **No hard stop, no park.** The ticket is ready.

## Evidence gate

Every claim traces to the gathered input (Context, Problem, Idea, Required outcomes). I invented no numbers, report names, labels, or URLs. The missing concrete example is recorded explicitly as `none (<reason>)`.

## Metadata audit

This is create mode and there are no tracker fields to preserve. There are no proposed metadata changes beyond the drafted title. Clean.

## Split detection

**No split proposed.** The input describes one end-to-end deliverable. Export and email delivery fix the same missing capability: a requester cannot get a CSV copy of a report. Dividing the work by repo (widgets vs. mailer) would be a split by location, which is never a valid split axis. The repo headings only show ownership.

## Comment

**None proposed.** The Idea keeps its single attributed sketch line with nothing left over, there is no overlap evidence, and there was no in-session ask.

## Wording contract (inline check)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Strip test | Pass |
| Plain-words lead per failure | Pass |
| Example or `none (reason)` per failure | Pass, `none` stated |
| No undefined jargon | Pass |
| No references needing parenthetical treatment | Pass |
| No links | Pass |

**Next:** Step 6 (no-op check) does not apply in create mode, so the draft goes to step 7 (Roast) and then to the confirmation gate.

## Full replacement ticket body

## Context
Requesters can view reports in acme/widgets but cannot receive a CSV copy of a report.

## Problem
Requesters cannot export the displayed report or have its CSV emailed to them. For example, a requester viewing a report with name and count columns cannot obtain those displayed rows as a CSV download or email attachment.

## Idea
The reporter proposes an Export CSV button in acme/widgets, with acme/mailer sending the exported file to the requester when email delivery is requested.

## Acceptance Criteria

### acme/widgets
- [ ] Given a report available to the requester, when the requester opens it, an Export CSV button is visible.
- [ ] Given an open report with displayed rows, when the requester clicks Export CSV, a CSV is exported containing the displayed rows and their name and count values, with columns named `name` and `count`.

### acme/mailer
- [ ] Given a CSV exported from the requester's displayed report and the requester's email address, when the requester asks for email delivery, acme/mailer sends an email to that address with that CSV attached.

---

## AC integrity gate report

**Result: PASS**

- All three criteria are normalized as unchecked checklist items.
- Each criterion is behavioral and names a setup, action, and observable expected result.
- The exported row set is bounded by the displayed report; the required column set is explicitly enumerated as `name` and `count`.
- All criteria are verifiable before production deployment; none requires a production-only observation.
- No wishful, tautological, unspecified-but-binding, or external-input criteria were found.
- Criteria are attributed under the two named repositories within **one end-to-end ticket**. No split is proposed.
- No overflow material exists; no comment is proposed.
